hook: You didn't know it was the last time.

lines.text: You didn't know it was the last time.
The last time your mom carried you to bed, pretending you were already asleep.
The last time you played outside until the streetlights came on.
The last time everyone sat around the same table, laughing at nothing.
Nobody tells you. There's no warning. No goodbye.
One day, it's just a memory.
So hug them a little longer. Stay a little later. Call back.
Because someday, this ordinary moment is the one you'd give anything to live again.

post.caption: You never get a warning before the last time. Who would you call today? 🤍
